Pomi is a round apple-green garden sprite the size of a melon, with one small sprout leaf on top of its head, big shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, tiny stubby arms and no legs (it hops and floats), softly glowing. Digby is a grumpy old grey mole with a red-and-white striped nightcap, round spectacles, big pink digging paws and a tiny pink nose.
